messages:
Maya (infra): FYI saw a 429 wave across eu-west during the nightly batch ramp at 05:12 UTC, sustained ~3k req/s spike.
Noah: Yep, queue on gpu-pool-eu-2 climbed to ~1.8k and admission dropped to keep latency SLOs.
SRE-Bot: alert: admission_rate drop 0.42 -> 0.18; queue_depth peak 1804; region eu-west.
Maya (infra): Hypothesis: client retries + global fanout amplified the pressure. We should give clients machine-readable hints so SDKs can back off more intelligently.
Noah: Agree. Current 429 is too blunt. Suggest a small header set to communicate local capacity and queueing.
Julia: What do you have in mind?
Maya (infra): Minimal proposal: `X-RW-Admit-Rate` (0-1 float), `X-RW-Queue-Depth` (int), `X-RW-Admit-TTL` (seconds), and an optional `X-RW-Admit-Reason`.
Noah: Example header payloads: `X-RW-Admit-Rate: 0.15`, `X-RW-Queue-Depth: 1200`, `X-RW-Admit-TTL: 3`, `X-RW-Admit-Reason: gpu-pool-overloaded`.
Julia: That would let SDKs decide between immediate retry, jittered retry, or cross-region fallback. Also helps observability for customers.
Kevin: Two quick asks: 1) define exact units and fallbacks when headers missing, 2) make it opt-out for private/dedicated deployments where customers might not want hints exposed.
Maya (infra): Good points. Default when header missing = conservative (assume admit-rate 0.2). Opt-out via a tenant config or `X-RW-Expose-Admit: false` at tenant level.
Noah: Proposed SDK behavior (high-level): on 429 -> parse headers -> if admit_rate < 0.2 => exponential backoff with longer base and extra jitter; if queue_depth > 1000 => add cap and randomized backoff window; if admit-ttl present honor for how long header is valid.
Julia: Pseudocode suggestion:
```
if resp.status == 429:
  admit = float(resp.headers.get('X-RW-Admit-Rate', 0.2))
  qd = int(resp.headers.get('X-RW-Queue-Depth', 0))
  ttl = int(resp.headers.get('X-RW-Admit-TTL', 0))
  if admit < 0.2:
    sleep = base_backoff * (0.2 / max(admit, 0.01)) * random(0.5, 1.5)
  elif qd > 1000:
    sleep = base_backoff * (1 + qd/1000.0) * random(0.8, 1.2)
  else:
    sleep = base_backoff * random(0.8, 1.2)
  schedule_retry(sleep, ttl)
```
Noah: We should also limit max retries per request chain to avoid infinite retry storms; maybe default 3 attempts for client-side retries when accept header is present.
Maya (infra): Implementation notes: runtime will compute admit-rate as a smoothed estimator over 1s window; queue-depth is current queue size; reason is freeform short tag. Admit-ttl should be small (1-5s) to avoid stale hints.
Kevin: Cost/regional implications: if SDKs fallback cross-region aggressively it could blow up egress and capacity in other regions. Recommend adding `X-RW-Region-Capacity` or `X-RW-Geo-Favor` hint: a token like `local|nearby|remote` to let SDKs prefer safe fallbacks.
Julia: Or keep region info minimal to avoid leaking topology; `X-RW-Geo-Hint: local|nearby|remote` is OK. Also telemetry flag so we can measure cross-region fallback rate.
ops-oncall: Created INF-472 ticket to track admit-proto v0.1 spec + infra work; assigned to eng-infra, ETA end of week.
Deploy-Bot: deploy: admit-proto/feature-flag enabled in staging for eu-west pools.
Maya (infra): Rollout plan: 1) spec + unit tests, 2) internal SDKs enabled behind flag (1 day), 3) staging canary (48h), 4) public SDK opt-in (2 weeks), 5) public enabled with gradual ramp (monitor obey-rate and error churn).
Noah: Observability: we need metrics: header_sent_ratio, header_ttl_miss, client_obey_rate, client_retry_rate_after_header. Instrumentation in SDKs required.
Julia: Also add a short human-readable reason for quick debug: `gpu-pool-overloaded`, `network-degraded`, `maintenance`. Keep reason tokens small.
Maya (infra): Security/privacy: ensure no tenant-identifying info in headers. Keep values coarse.
Kevin: One more: TTL should be included in logs so we can correlate stale-handling bugs.
Maya (infra): I'll draft the spec and a small sim harness to validate that SDK heuristics reduce amplification. Will also prepare example JS/Python snippet for the SDK team.
Noah: SDKs will need explicit tests to verify respect of admit-rate and that they don't aggressively fallback cross-region unless allowed.
Julia: +1. Also add e2e canary to run during low-traffic windows to observe behavior.
Maya (infra): Thanks folks — I'll post the PR for spec and link to INF-472. :thumbsup:
Noah: Thanks — will review the PR and prep SDK testcases.
ops-oncall: tagging oncall for visibility: @oncall-eng-sre
Maya (infra): ping if anyone spots any glaring omission.
Julia: none from me, looks solid. :slightly_smiling_face:
